Flight Planning

karar mesafesi mevcut

Distance from threshold to point on runway where go‑around decision altitude is reached, allowing a missed‑approach before runway end.

Kisa cevap: Distance from threshold to point on runway where go‑around decision altitude is reached, allowing a missed‑approach before runway end.

Neden onemli

karar mesafesi mevcut, Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew icin Flight Planning baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, ve EASA FCL.055 gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

karar mesafesi mevcut nedir?
